brown_chicken_rice.name: Brown chicken rice (prototype serving)
brown_chicken_rice.description: A simplified one-serving model based on the Singapore HPB Brown Chicken Rice recipe. Calculated ingredients include Foundation Foods dry white rice, cooked braised chicken breast, and raw bok choy as a composition proxy. Broth, aromatics, cooking oil, sauces and the bok choy cooking-yield change are not modeled, so totals are incomplete. Rice uses the USDA Foundation Foods raw entry. Its dry-weight amount is an illustrative prototype portion, not a USDA cooking-yield conversion; cooking water, final cooked mass, and cooking-related nutrient changes are not included in totals.

source.name: Singapore Health Promotion Board, Brown Chicken Rice
source.basis: Adapted one-serving composition; the dry-rice amount is an illustrative prototype portion, not a USDA cooking-yield conversion. Nutrient values come only from linked USDA Foundation Foods records. Broth, oil, aromatics, sauces and recipe cooking changes are omitted.

method: Cook the listed dry rice in water; its dry weight is used for nutrient calculation.
Slice the cooked chicken and serve over the rice.
